flags: The stated duration is approximate and months have unequal lengths; reasonable interpretations all select 60,000 miles per hour.

routes.label: Estimate distance divided by travel time after converting to hours

question: NASA’s Perseverance Rover was launched on July \(30,\) \(2020.\) After traveling \(292{,}526{,}838\) miles, it landed on Mars in Jezero Crater about \(6.5\) months later. Which of the following is closest to the Rover’s average interplanetary speed in miles per hour?
solution:
Average speed is total distance divided by total travel time. Since the choices are far apart and the trip length is approximate, round the distance to \(300{,}000{,}000\) miles and take about \(30\) days per month.

The travel time is about

\[
6.5\cdot30=195\text{ days},
\]

or about \(200\cdot24=4800\) hours. Rounding this to \(5000\) hours makes the speed estimate easy:

\[
\frac{300{,}000{,}000\text{ miles}}{5000\text{ hours}}
=60{,}000\text{ miles per hour}.
\]

The closest choice is \(\boxed{60{,}000}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\). Converting months to hours before dividing keeps the units consistent.
